sqi-server

The server is running. The full web UI has not shipped yet — until it does, this page links to the API specification and operational endpoints exposed by the binary.

API

  • /api/v1/openapi.yaml OpenAPI 3.1 specification
  • /api/v1/jobs Jobs collection
  • /api/v1/workers Registered workers

Health & metrics

  • /healthz Liveness probe
  • /readyz Readiness probe (SQLite + NATS)
  • /metrics Prometheus metrics
